basic_info.description: Located in a 1923 elevator building in Pacific Heights, this condo spans the entire width of the building, with grand-scale rooms, tall ceilings & beautifully preserved 1920s details like original crown molding & arched hallway ceilings.   A grand entry foyer leads to expansive living & dining rooms lined w/ oversized south-facing windows that fill the space w/ natural light, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace. Off the main living area, a bonus room with a full bath and in-unit W/D can serve as an office, library or be reconfigured into a 3rd en-suite bedroom. The renovated Chef's kitchen is sleek & functional appointed w/ marble countertops, Thermador cooktop, Bosch double oven, dishwasher & wine fridge, plus a breakfast bar for casual dining. Each of the two bedrooms are en-suite, including a light-filled primary suite with a walk-in closet and spacious bath and a 2nd suite just across the hall.  2 garage parking spaces on the block (1701 Jackson), private storage, bike room & shared yard with fruit trees. This secure building is pet-friendly and has a dog run.   Set just 2 blocks from Polk St, this prime Pac Heights location offers effortless access to cafs, dining & green space. Lafayette Park is just moments away w/ tennis courts, off-leash dog area & sweeping Bay views.
